paragraphs.text: Teneb (TEHN-ehb ), the Harvester , is a male primeval dragon on Dominaria in an alternate timeline.

Teneb is a male primeval dragon from Dominaria that was seen during the Temporal crisis of Dominaria . He is a large black-scaled dragon with yellow-colored wings. He wears golden jewelry around his nose and on his head.
The four other alternate timeline primeval dragons are Intet , Numot , Oros , and Vorosh .
